description.en: AI preview and analysis for game 3D model / animation assets: clip lists, skeleton stats, mesh stats, viewpoint screenshots, motion analysis, skeleton identification and standalone mesh binding for motion-only assets.
description.zh: 面向游戏 3D 模型/动画资源的 AI 预览与分析：动画片段清单、骨骼与网格统计、按视角渲染截图、动作分析与骨架识别；动作不带 mesh 时可绑定独立网格文件（内容扫描自动识别 + 按骨骼名绑定），独立预览页带进程内层级列表。
